revisions.note: Resumed from the rev-1 seed. The shim source is unchanged (and stays byte-identical to the deployed A31 copy); this pass added the missing piece the briq asks for - a test that pins the exact A32 LD_PRELOAD invocation chain and records the object hashes. The aarch64 .so could not be rebuilt in THIS environment (no cross compiler, guest unreachable); that is reported, not hidden, and the recorded hash still matches the unchanged source.
